derivation:
by
  apply RingEquiv.ext; intro p; apply Subtype.ext
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (renameEquiv_trans (R := R) e f) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R)
explanation: Mathlib proves the composition law for unrestricted renaming. Evaluating it on a restricted series and applying subtype extensionality gives this theorem; restrictedRenameEquiv definitionally uses the same underlying maps.
